class.name: LRTVolume3D
class.description:
Shared coarse geometry uses [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/voxel/cell_size[/code], in asset-local metres, defaulting to 0.125. Resolution is the ceiling of the longest mesh bounding-box axis divided by that target. MeshInstance3D and MultiMeshInstance3D expose an optional Voxel Cell Size override in the Inspector's Global Illumination > LRT subsection. Unchecked instances follow the project setting; checked instances override it with their own positive size. The override is stored as [code]_lrt_voxel_cell_size[/code] node metadata. MultiMesh copies share the template setting. Instances using the same effective specification continue to share captures. Thin features and gaps do not automatically refine an asset. The specification is independent of Volume probe spacing and instance scale; scaling an instance also scales the approximation. Changing the setting invalidates live resolution estimates; unchanged specifications continue to share geometry. Construction stores conservative surface coverage and normals, without generating signed distances, projecting to the nearest surface or flood-filling closed room interiors.
Owns one [LRTVolume] and everything around it: it reads inputs from the same [World3D], prepares shared coarse geometry and per-instance material fields on worker threads, evaluates native incoming lighting at Probe centers, recomposes sparse total Source, propagates fixed six-face RGB SH4 transport and draws the migrated diffuse result on the scene’s own standard materials. All scene meshes, including BoxMesh, use the same GPU geometry/material capture path. Captures are read back asynchronously and decoded on worker threads. A triangle-box overlap filter in the exact capture lattice removes falsely covered cells without filling GPU-discarded alpha holes. Filtered coverage is persisted and reused on cache loads and instance transforms; normal whole-cell boundary expansion remains. Native lighting retains only light parameters, Trunk candidate IDs and shared shadow/projector/area-atlas inputs, not per-light radiance fields or surface-receiver pages. Color, energy, indirect energy, temperature and negative sign trigger total Source recomposition. Directional lights use Volume-owned depth maps rasterized from original scene geometry through the native Forward+ shadow pass, independently of the main camera and native cascades. Each shadowed directional light uses one D32F layer, with a default resolution of 512 controlled by [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/directional_shadow/resolution[/code]. The independent [code]rendering/global_illumination/lrt/directional_shadow/bias[/code] defaults to 0.02 Volume-local metres; native directional shadow bias and normal bias do not control this map. Caster geometry, deformation, material input, light direction, caster mask or coverage changes redraw it; ordinary camera motion and light color or energy changes do not. Material edits conservatively invalidate the map, even for albedo-only edits. The caster query includes geometry outside the Volume along the light direction and geometry with GI_MODE_DISABLED. Native Alpha Scissor, Alpha Hash, shader discard, skeleton and vertex deformation, Shadow Only, double-sided shadows, mirrored transforms and reverse culling are preserved. Caster bounds must include any deformed geometry. These shadow maps do not use voxelized geometry or extra Viewports. Local lights continue to sample native shadow atlases.
For LRT, [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DISABLED] receives indirect light without contributing to the local field. Both [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC] and [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC] reuse mesh-local voxels. Translation, rotation, non-uniform scaling and mirrored transforms update affected Trunks without recapturing geometry or materials. Hidden objects and objects outside the Volume retain their local capture while their source remains alive. Geometry contribution supports [MeshInstance3D], authored [MultiMeshInstance3D] copies, [GridMap] render meshes, and the final mesh of a CSG root. CSG operands are not collected separately. CPU and GPU particles do not contribute geometry or emission. Other native geometry can still receive LRT.
GI voxel capture supports static [BaseMaterial3D] inputs: textures, vertex colors, material overrides, Overlay, Next Pass, Alpha Scissor, Alpha Hash and emission. It uses a private identity-transform mesh proxy with authored vertex arrays, without skeleton attributes, BlendShape targets or source instance shader uniforms. ShaderMaterial is reported as unsupported. Grow, Billboard, Fixed Size, Height Mapping, Distance Fade and world-space Triplanar are disabled on capture material copies; Triplanar is evaluated in mesh-local coordinates. These restrictions affect GI geometry inputs only, not the original materials or native shadow rendering. Receive-only standard-material passes are excluded independently. Contributing surfaces block both directions; emission follows authored culling.
MultiMesh copies share their template voxels. Distinct instance colors use cached static material variants, preserving native vertex-color and alpha evaluation. Instance transforms and visible instance counts do not invalidate these variants. Prepared local captures are stored as compressed native voxel bytes, keyed by mesh, supported material content and capture precision rather than instance transforms. Export preparation includes contributors outside the initial Volume and packs their captures under [code]res://.godot/lrt_export[/code], so later movement can load them without voxel drawing. New mesh, material, precision and instance-color variants must be prepared in the editor. Runtime only reuses or loads fully prepared captures; missing dependencies report an error and exclude the Volume from composition instead of generating voxels.
Opaque receivers use direct low-resolution Screen Gather from the latest RGB SH4 Radiance A/B and the sky visibility coefficients derived from the published direction mask. Gather uses eight-probe trilinear interpolation, including zero occupied samples, and composites separate RGBA16F lighting/coverage and R16F sky visibility outputs. There is no display history, light pyramid, spatial filter or explicit upsampling pass. Gather outputs are consumed only after every view completes successfully for the current render. Allocation or gather failure disables LRT composition for that view instead of reusing old coverage. Transparent surfaces retain native lighting. Input changes refill a finite RGB propagation budget; exhausted Volumes preserve their final radiance while Screen Gather continues on rendered frames. The probe grid and history live in this node's local space, so a rigidly moving or rotating parent carries them without rebuilding. Scaling this volume or one of its parents is rejected, while collected mesh instances may use arbitrary non-uniform scale. The editor draws the volume box with the same gizmo as a ReflectionProbe. Six face handles resize it, while a seventh handle edits the shared six-face blend distance.
In the editor, a new volume and changes to [member size] or [member probe_spacing] queue an asynchronous rebuild. The previous result remains visible until the new field is ready. Runtime can rebuild local transport for the latest configuration using prepared voxel assets; it never starts voxel capture. Switching editor scene tabs retains input revisions, local fields and pending worker work. Ordinary scene saves serialize the prepared cache identity without baking or waiting for work; new mesh, material or precision variants require an explicit rebuild or export preparation. Valid local-field data is cached under [code].godot/lrt[/code] and restored by content fingerprint. LRT diagnostics are viewport-owned modes under [b]View > Display Advanced... > LRT[/b], alongside VoxelGI and Dynamic GI diagnostics.
When [member external_gi_enabled] is enabled, LRT samples the native HDDAGI diffuse field at each outgoing face connection's external neighbor, using irradiance divided by PI as a wide-angle incident RGB approximation. Only boundary connections are stored. Unchanged published inputs reuse their samples; provider loss clears them and restarts the finite propagation budget. LRT never writes back to HDDAGI. Its mixed sky and bounced lighting are accepted and can overlap with local sky contributions. Disabling [member receive_sky] only disables local sky, not sky already mixed into external GI. Hidden Volumes stop preparing and solving inputs and leave composition, retaining their resources until shown again.

method.name: clear_shared_mesh_capture_cache
method.description: Clears the weak registry of shared mesh captures. Existing Volumes and in-flight builds retain their active data. New captures may publish replacement snapshots without invalidating those users.

method.name: prepare_mesh_sdf
method.description: Prepares conservative geometry coverage without changing the mesh or scene. A resolution of zero uses the asset bounds and global target cell size, without thickness or gap heuristics. The selected resolution is returned as [code]resolution[/code]. Returns [code]ok[/code], the content [code]signature[/code], cache and packed paths, and whether existing data was loaded. Failures return an [code]error[/code]. Material changes do not change this signature. Exported projects write generated data to [code]user://lrt_cache[/code].

method.name: get_build_stats
method.description: Probe, receiver and timing counters of the last applied bake. [code]snapshot_reused[/code] reports whether the worker reused the inactive CPU bank; [code]snapshot_sync_probes[/code] counts probes copied from the published field to bring that bank current. [code]queue_wait_ms[/code] measures the wait from prepared geometry inputs to worker entry, including asynchronous capture readback and worker scheduling. [code]capture_decode_ms[/code] measures static material and voxel capture decoding on the worker; it is included in [code]worker_total_ms[/code], not in queue wait.

method.name: get_preparation_status
method.description: Returns preparation state and generation together with scheduler work, queue age, application latency, native light-input submissions, Source updates and propagation counters. [code]render_bridge_performance[/code] reports native-input boundary sampling, opaque Screen Gather and active debug drawing. [code]lrt_total_gpu_bytes[/code] sums allocated Volume, shared and per-viewport screen resource payloads; driver object overhead is excluded. [code]propagation_iterations_per_frame[/code] reports the configured fixed iteration count for each active Volume. [code]last_frame_propagation_iterations[/code] reports the batch actually submitted by this Volume on its latest update. CPU and GPU timings are diagnostic and do not throttle updates. In [code]frame_cpu_breakdown[/code], [code]geometry_input_ms[/code] measures synchronous geometry preparation and capture submission during the latest poll, including failed attempts. [code]geometry_update_ms[/code] includes collection, signatures, cache lookup, preparation and capture submission; it overlaps the individual geometry timings and must not be added to them. [code]geometry_update_count[/code] counts completed automatic checks. Each Volume updates independently of other Volumes and measured preparation cost. [code]voxel_captures[/code] counts native raster capture submissions, [code]voxel_capture_reuses[/code] counts in-memory reuse, and [code]voxel_cache_loads[/code] counts prepared capture loads. Counters reset with the node and exclude analytic Box generation. Instance transforms do not increase raster capture submissions. [code]mesh_capture_active_bytes[/code] counts unique capture-array payloads held by this Volume. [code]mesh_capture_shared_cache_bytes[/code] counts unique payloads in the shared registry's current live snapshots; [code]mesh_capture_shared_cache_entries[/code] counts those snapshots. These byte counts exclude object and allocator overhead and overlap the active bytes, so they must not be added together. Captures have no memory budget or LRU retention. Hidden Volumes keep their references; the last user releases the snapshot and its registry entry. An older revision can remain alive in another Volume or an in-flight build after the registry has published its replacement.

method.name: get_cancelled_builds
method.description: Number of background bakes that were superseded and thrown away.

method.name: get_dropped_builds
method.description: Number of finished bakes that were discarded because a newer one already existed.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Last configuration or build error, or an empty string.

method.name: get_geometry_builds
method.description: Number of local fields this node has built and applied.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_status
method.description: Returns the instance's contribution/build state from the latest collection. Unsupported contributing materials return [code]Failed[/code]. Use [method get_instance_sdf_message] for the material error or contribution details.

method.name: get_instance_sdf_message
method.description: Returns the Inspector's explanation of mesh-local voxel reuse, receive-only geometry, excluded particles, or unsupported material inputs. The report describes the latest collection by this Volume.

method.name: get_solver
method.description: The underlying solver, for diagnostics and parity checks.

method.name: get_sky_radiance
method.description: Returns the Godot environment radiance projected into three RGB SH4 vectors in this Volume's local frame. This is the production input for equal-weight reconstruction at the 26 lattice directions.

method.name: get_volume_warnings
method.description: Configuration warnings of this volume, including transform restrictions and ambiguous external Dynamic GI sky ownership.

method.name: is_building
method.description: Whether a bake is queued, a background bake is running, or a local-field upload is pending. Queued work may wait for an active bake or upload to complete, or for rebuild suppression to end.

method.name: poll
method.description: Runs one frame of the node's scheduler immediately: input refresh, completed worker/upload work, light-capture progress and fixed-count propagation. Scripts and test tools use it to drive the volume without waiting for process frames.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Collects the scene inputs for immediate inspection and queues a forced background bake. Capture submission starts during a later poll after collecting fresh inputs, once any active bake or local-field upload permits a new build.

method.name: set_rebuild_suppressed
method.description: Holds rebuilds while an editor drag resizes the volume; releasing it bakes once for the final state.

members.member: Controls overlap ordering. Higher priorities cover lower ones; equal priorities use scene-tree order, with later nodes covering earlier nodes. Boundary transitions reveal the lower Volume or the native environment. Volumes solve independently and do not exchange radiance.
Distance from each outer face over which Coverage transitions between LRT and native indirect lighting. Sky visibility uses the same coverage weight. Zero disables boundary blending.
Whether the volume also builds and draws while the scene is open in the editor.
Probe spacing in metres. Smaller values increase spatial detail and memory use.
Size of the probe region in metres, centred on the node's position.

Enables independent 26-direction sky visibility and local SkyBounce in Source. Disabling it removes local sky input, stops sky work and retains the geometry cache. Re-enabling reuses a complete result only when its geometry version is current. Lights and surface emission remain active.
Enables optional boundary input from a compatible diffuse GI provider. This does not enable or configure another GI system.
